name: VIGIL — duplicate payment settlement transaction id
description: Detects the same transaction id appearing at least twice in the duplicate-settlement evaluation profile. Transaction-id grouping is the signal; no host, user, account, address, or transaction literal is pinned. The rule is disabled until replayed and validated in an isolated live index.
query: labels.dataset: "vigil-synthetic-eval" and event.category: web and event.action: upi_transfer and vigil.transaction.profile: "duplicate_settlement"
